caveats: Long parallel greedy token parity remains unresolved; mismatched runs do not support speedup claims.
FP32 head probes used runtime instrumentation and were not shipped.
CUDA Graph covers target one-token decode only.
Continuous refill is an offline CLI scheduler, not the HTTP/overlap scheduler.
Three-run medians are local observations, not confidence intervals or production benchmarks.
TTFT between fixed waves and continuous mode has different queue-arrival semantics; do not compare those means.
Weights and 27B INT4 support were not changed.
